versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Native-style QWERTY rows and wide Space; side tools follow one-handed layout; native Liquid Glass, removable backgrounds on every key, custom colors/opacity/spacing/height and real keyboard preview. Retains native text replacements, number row, emoji, OTP Shortcuts, Windows clipboard and direct TV typing. Host plus keyboard only.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 48 removes duplicate background layers in Background: iOS mode and corrects app/keyboard bundle versions. Compilation and IPA audit passed. Full-screen UI and device verification remain incomplete. Unsigned IPA includes the main app and one keyboard extension; provision both IDs when signing.
versions.changelog: Native background update: transparent input root and no duplicate rounded glass panel in Background: iOS, the default for glass/System themes. Normal and removed keycaps supported; compact height retained. Background: Custom retains separate glass/tint/photo options. Corrected actual app and keyboard bundle metadata to version 0.2.0, build 48, with exact-version IPA audit. Published at the owner's request before full-screen UI verification completed. Physical-device appearance remains unverified; iOS controls margins and globe area outside the extension.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 47 removes Aukkhor's duplicate background layers in Background: iOS mode. Full-screen UI and physical-device verification remain incomplete. Unsigned IPA includes the main app and one keyboard extension; preserve and provision both bundle IDs when signing.
versions.changelog: Native background update: transparent input root and no duplicate rounded glass panel with Background: iOS (default for glass/System themes). Works with normal keycaps and Keycaps: None; retains compact height. Background: Custom keeps separate Clear/Frosted glass, tint and photos. Compiled with Xcode 27.1 and passed host/keyboard IPA audit. Published at the owner's request before full-screen UI verification completed. Physical iPhone appearance remains unverified; iOS controls margins and the globe strip outside the extension.

versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Glass rendering correction: adaptive Frosted glass is the default for unset preferences; explicit Clear choices are preserved. Restore the native keyboard backdrop and refresh the canvas material after window presentation. Clear/Frosted controls now refresh the app preview. Retains build 37 compact height and removable keycaps. Eight simulator tests passed, including pixel checks over a black responder host on first opening and reopening; physical-device appearance remains unverified.

versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Shorter keyboard: default typing area reduced from 220 to 196 pt, or 269 to 239 pt with numbers. Tighter vertical row spacing, no added footer or bottom padding. New Keyboard height slider (85-115%, default 90%) also applies to existing installs. Retains whole-keyboard native Liquid Glass, Clear/Frosted and tint controls, removable keycaps, English/Bangla typing and side tools. All seven simulator tests passed, including 96 layout combinations.

versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Whole-keyboard native Liquid Glass stays active with Keycaps: None, including Space and the settings panel. Choose Clear or Frosted glass, tint strength and touch response. Clear follows the host appearance; Frosted adapts for text contrast. Retains compact native-style rows, side tools, optional number row, English/Bangla typing, emoji, text replacements and Windows/TV tools. Seven simulator tests passed, including 96 layout combinations.
